purpose: Create the frozen train-only full-hierarchy source for the next representation/model comparison after the mixture-Transformer hard stop.

representation.dynamic_root: float32 source-space root translations, normalized from an authored start anchor only when a training window is requested
representation.dynamic_rotation: float32 sign-continuous WXYZ quaternions for every retained ancestor-local joint; the root quaternion is world orientation
representation.proportions: per-clip float32 offsets normalized by the semantic body reference scale, plus a float64 source scale
representation.coordinates: per-clip float64 rest reference and rest pelvis rotation preserve the existing observation-derived normalization contract
representation.semantic_layer: the fixed 17 semantic joint indices remain animator controls and evaluation targets
representation.velocity: root linear and joint-local angular velocities are derived from consecutive stored frames and exact per-clip dt during window materialization
representation.authored_masks: deterministic sparse masks address semantic animator controls; retained helper joints are never presented as authored controls
representation.motion_tags: weak metadata tags derived from source descriptions and existing style tags; explicitly not intent ground truth

storage.format: Six NumPy .npy arrays plus checked JSON layout/report
